title: Implement Norn Project Web 2.1.0
objective: Deliver the complete secured EN/FR Web project-tracking application, its durable governance model, human document projection, read-only live observation, build integration, documentation and release evidence.
plan_statement: Implement contracts and reusable projections first, then filesystem stores and the loopback inbound adapter, then the bridge-driven renderer, operational governance and live invalidations, and finally package and verify the release as one coherent Feature.
recommended_breakdown: L1 - canonical contracts and reusable projections
L4 - human governance and operational actions
L5 - live observation and relationship graph
L6 - distribution, documentation and release gates
expected_output: A publishable arka-norn 2.1.0 tarball containing dist/web, a functional arka-norn web command, complete real-data views and passing unit, integration, E2E, accessibility, security and packaging evidence.
